sources.title: Project After contributors: hand-set species values

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added with the lilies work (2026-10-18): every character from the floras in the lilies notes (plantgen-claude project-files/lilies/SOURCES.md), drawn by the rules its taxa hold; drawing values only where no character says them.

taxon.note: WCVP v16 accepted name Lilium bolanderi, plant_name_id 280732.

growth_form.note: A bulbous herb with one leafy flowering stem a year, drawn by the forb form.

growth.note: Grown five years from seed, as a lily bulb takes three to five to flower; drawn at its third and fifth years.

variants.note: One seed in the open, as the built-in species.

allometry.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: stems usually 0.3-0.9 m; FNA gives only 'stems to 1.1 m'. Its reference height is the middle of that range, 0.6 m, at its last keyframe.

traits.height_typical_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: stems usually 0.3-0.9 m; FNA gives only 'stems to 1.1 m'.

traits.leaf_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium bolanderi (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): blade noticeably glaucous; drawn a grey-green. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium bolanderi (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stems to 1.1 m, glaucous

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium bolanderi (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves in 1-5(-6) whorls or partial whorls

traits.leaf_whorls.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium bolanderi (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): in 1-5(-6) whorls. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.leaves_per_whorl.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium bolanderi (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): 3-19 leaves per whorl. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium bolanderi (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves 1.8-7.1 x 0.7-2.8 cm

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium bolanderi (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves 0.7-2.8 cm wide, 2.2-4.8 times longer than wide

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium bolanderi (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): blade more or less obovate, oblanceolate, or occasionally elliptic

traits.leaf_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium bolanderi (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves ascending and often cupping stem

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium bolanderi (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): inflorescences usually umbellate in small plants, in large plants racemose or in 2 whorls, 1-9-flowered. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.flower_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium bolanderi (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): flowers nodding to horizontal, not fragrant

traits.corolla_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium bolanderi (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): perianth more or less campanulate or funnelform

traits.perianth_reflexion.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium bolanderi (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): sepals and petals somewhat recurved 3/5-4/5 along length from base

traits.perianth_reflexion_from.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium bolanderi (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): recurved 3/5-4/5 along length from base

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium bolanderi (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): red or magenta, occasionally salmon pink or pale yellow The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.perianth_spots.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium bolanderi (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): with maroon spots

traits.perianth_spot_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium bolanderi (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): maroon spots The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.tepal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium bolanderi (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): sepals 3.1-4.7 cm, petals 3-4.5 cm

traits.stamen_exsertion.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium bolanderi (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stamens included

traits.anther_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium bolanderi (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): anthers reddish or magenta The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.pedicel_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium bolanderi (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): pedicel 0.8-14.2 cm. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium bolanderi (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): capsules 2-4.1 x 1.2-2.1 cm

traits.fruit_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium bolanderi (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): capsules 1.2-2.1 cm wide

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium bolanderi (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): flowering summer (mid Jun-mid Aug)
